github_repository.description: Original BEAST 1.10.4 discrete trait analysis XML containing alignment, temporal calibration, and trait states

paper.pdf.description: Authentic published open-access paper PDF from PMC12146690 / Genome Biology and Evolution

alignment.fasta.description: Multiple sequence alignment of whole ASFV genomes in FASTA format (exact sequence parity with BEAST XML, no imputation)

dates.csv.description: Collection dates in decimal years extracted from BEAST XML taxon date attributes

beast_config.xml.gz.description: Gzip-compressed BEAST 1.10.4 input XML harvested from official study GitHub repository

published_beast_parameters.clock_model: Relaxed molecular clock (uncorrelated lognormal distribution, UCLD)
published_beast_parameters.discrete_traits: Discrete phylogeographic diffusion model with BSSVS

tmrca.description: Time of the most recent common ancestor of the ASFV European clade

published_beast_parameters.verbatim_quote: With this time-scaled phylogenetic inference, we estimate for ASFV an evolutionary rate of 5.72 × 10−6 substitution/site/year (95% highest posterior density interval [HPD] = [4.38 × 10−6, 7.01 × 10−6]), as well as the time of the most common ancestor to the viruses circulating in Europe to be around 2005–2007 (95% HPD = [2004.6, 2007.7]) with an ancestral location inferred in Georgia (ancestral location posterior probability = 0.86).
